real_window: each MAT raw event window only, approximately10ms; no union of adjacent windows
real_coordinates: raw events undistorted with official K and distortion, then binned; PnP uses ideal K
keypoints: original CAD AABB centroid then eight lexicographic min/max corners; not legacy stored UV
pnp: fixed OpenCV SOLVEPNP_EPNP, eight corners, no GT choice of cells/solutions
primary_metric: ADD-S mean and success at0.1*exact mesh diameter; all200 denominator, PnP failures count as unsuccessful
metric_scope: derived corrected geometry pilot; not a claimed reproduction of official full E-POSE leaderboard protocol
scope: synthetic-only full-network centroid classification training adapter; fixed fresh real pilot, not original SingleShotPose training reproduction
model: same pinned SingleShotPose architecture, 20-channel output and full-frame count input416
learning_rate_schedule: linear warmup20 updates, factor0.1 after update150
objective: original keypoint coordinate MSE plus standard cross entropy for169 centroid-grid classes; both arms identical
batchnorm: running buffers frozen; affine parameters trained
augmentation: same128 train affine views from16 physical windows; registry shared
checkpoint_selection: fixed final200 updates, both synthetic gates must pass before any fresh real scoring
input: full-frame events only; no GT mask/crop/box/cell at inference
training_lineage: v1 full496; v2+v3 output20000; v4 full400; v5 center linear classification; v6 full200 center classification
deadline_policy: training1800s, synthetic verification300s, real eval600s, real verification300s
